canon-three-body:dx3906.x: Dim red dwarf system gifted to Cheng Xin by Yun Tianming in Death’s End, orbiting two terrestrial worlds (Planet Blue and Planet Gray) where Cheng Xin and Guan Yifan experience curvature-propulsion death lines.

phoebe.x: Retrograde irregular moon of Saturn captured from interstellar space, where Protogen discovered the extrasolar Protomolecule.
phoebe.a: James S. A. Corey (Daniel Abraham & Ty Franck)

mars.x: Subsurface domed settlements and headquarters of the Free Mars movement fighting for independence from Earth.
First settlement (Underhill) and the elevator tether city (Sheffield atop Pavonis Mons) chronicled across two centuries of planetary transformation.
Exploration habitat in Acidalia Planitia where botanist Mark Watney survives for 549 sols using potato farming and hydrazine extraction.
Subterranean alien ruins discovered in Promethei Planitia on Mars, revealing mass-effect physics and interstellar blueprints.
Deep-shaft underground mining city on Mars housing the Deimos Staryards offices and industrial extraction workforce.
Thriving crater metropolis on Mars serving as humanity’s primary commercial and cultural capital after the devastation of Earth.
First permanent Martian research colony founded in 1995 during the competitive tri-party expedition between NASA, Helios, and the USSR.
mars.a: Ronald D. Moore / Matt Wolpert / Ben Nedivi

mars.x: Desert home of the ancient non-human Martian Old Ones in Stranger in a Strange Land, and capital city Marsopolis in Double Star.
Site of Nigel Sheldon and Ozzie Isaacs’ historic 2015 wormhole touchdown on the red planet, initiating the Intersolar Commonwealth.
Primary naval garrison and orbital construction shipyards of the North American Commonwealth Armed Forces.
Vast mobile Martian city creeping along tracks across the sands, whose citizens trade memory and lifespans through the cryptographic Time currency.
Brainwashed human army assembled under Winston Niles Rumfoord in The Sirens of Titan, and oligarchic jaunte-landing domains in The Stars My Destination.

Bleak, sweltering Martian draft colonies where depressed colonists escape isolation through the shared illusion of Can-D Perky Pat layouts, and the hazardous mining frontier of synthetic Nexus androids.
mars.w: The Three Stigmata of Palmer Eldritch

mars.x: Poetic canals, dying seas, and telepathic crystal cities in Ray Bradbury’s Martian Chronicles, and the desiccated red home of the ruthless tripod-launching invaders in H. G. Wells’ War of the Worlds.
mars.a: Ray Bradbury, H. G. Wells, Jules Verne

mars.x: Cydonia Mensae landing site where the Mars-1 and Mars-2 rescue teams discover an ancient artificial face harboring an alien biosphere archive.
Ancient warlike red homeworld of the armored Martian Ice Warriors in Doctor Who, and the opulent Mars University founded by the Wong family in Futurama.
Planetary surface explored by Viking, Pathfinder, Spirit, Opportunity, Curiosity, and Perseverance searching for ancient biosignatures.

hip-69673.x: Capital station of the Systems Alliance situated at a critical mass-relay nexus 36 light-years from Earth in the Arcturus system.
Spectacular red giant star Arcturus passed at close range by the sleeper starship Avalon during its 120-year voyage to Homestead II.
